entities.name: Madarrak
entities.description: Izzet guildmage and scientist who found the missing chemister Erno Zslod and his focusing lens.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: Izzet chemister missing for over thirty years, found as a preserved head in a helmet and killed by a mutant.

entities.name: Castan
entities.description: Vedalken apprentice of Madarrak left behind in the Undercity.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet guildmaster who examined the device.

entities.name: Yzaak
entities.description: Cyclops retainer who putrefied in the Undercity.

entities.name: Johrum
entities.description: Erno's attendant who became a fire-twisted being.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Insectoid warriors who attacked in the Undercity.

events.summary: Madarrak and Castan find a homing beacon in the rubble of their lab and bring it to Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: Madarrak brought the strange device to Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: Madarrak is told the device belonged to the long-vanished Erno Zslod and is sent to follow it.
events.quote: Madarrak was bid to follow the device and locate its target

events.summary: Madarrak, Castan and Yzaak enter the Undercity.
events.quote: Madarrak entered the Undercity of Ravnica

events.summary: Madarrak finds Erno Zslod's living head in a mizzium helmet.
events.quote: the still-alive head of none other than Erno Zslod

events.summary: Erno explains his illness, blamed on a Simic biomancer's ooze, and how his lens brought him to the Undercity.
events.quote: Erno said it was a Simic biomancer who was behind the illness

events.summary: Kraul attack and a deformed mutant pins Madarrak.
events.quote: a monstrously deformed human who launched itself at Madarrak

events.summary: Johrum rescues Madarrak, and the mutant kills Erno Zslod.
events.quote: finally ending the mad chemister's life

events.summary: Madarrak kills the mutant, finds Yzaak putrefied, and teleports away with the lens, leaving Castan.
events.quote: Madarrak then killed the mutant with a steam gun

events.summary: Madarrak delivers the lens to Niv-Mizzet, then realizes he is infected with the biomancer's ooze.
events.quote: He had been infected with the biomancer's ooze

relations.note: Madarrak found him; his device led Madarrak to him
relations.quote: the still-alive head of none other than Erno Zslod
who put him in his good graces
